newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Guangdong sees Jan-July exports up 31 pct.
newsitem.headline: China's Guangdong sees Jan-July exports up 31 pct.

text.p: Exports by China's booming southern province of Guangdong surged 31 percent to $39.3 billion in the first seven months of 1997 compared with the year-ago period, the Xinhua news agency said.
The province registered a trade surplus of $14.8 billion for the January-July period, Xinhua said in an overnight report seen on Friday.
Officials attributed the rapid growth in exports to the soft landing of the economy, the expanding global market and the restructuring of Guangdong's trading companies.
Exports from the province's Maoming and Qingyuan cities skyrocketed 200 percent, while those from Meizhou, Shanwei and Jieyang soared 100 percent, Xinhua said without giving further details.
